root_cause: consume_telemetry_events (main.py) synchronously calls the incidents API per event with PANTHEON_INCIDENTS_API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=90, while consumer.post_events used a fixed 10s client timeout; a bare TimeoutError from getresponse() was not mapped to RuntimeError so the retry loop missed it and main re-raised. Derived from code reading; no live measurement was possible from the worker (no hosted access).
fix: post_events maps OSError (covers TimeoutError, resets) to RuntimeError -> existing attempt/backoff/dead-letter path; client timeout is now RECONCILIATION_DRIFT_CONSUMER_POST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS default 100s (bounded, > 90s downstream bound).

call_sites.handling: HTTPError/URLError/OSError -> RuntimeError -> retry loop, last_error recorded, dead-letter after max_attempts
already maps HTTPError, URLError, OSError, JSONDecodeError
wrapped by except Exception at :295, recorded as worker state
called via _retry_operation which catches Exception and records attempts/errors
now also maps OSError/TimeoutError -> HTTPException 502 (previously only HTTPError/URLError; bare TimeoutError would 500); latency logged in finally
HTTPError/URLError handled with retryable_error result (pre-existing; not changed)

non_transient_errors: unchanged: only OSError/URLError/HTTPError converted; other exceptions still propagate and fail the tick (test_post_events_non_transient_error_still_raises)

measurement: The 100s consume bound is derived from PANTHEON_INCIDENTS_API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=90 (+10s margin) pending measurement. The consumer now logs 'consume post ok/failed in Ns' per request and the service logs 'incidents call took Ns' (no payloads); the next hosted deploy yields measured values to confirm or tighten the bound.
tick_budget: run_runtime_summary_consumer_once takes tick_budget_seconds (default 120s): no new attempt starts once spent; remaining events stay pending for the next tick. Worst tick ~120s+100s post+backoff < RECONCILIATION_DRIFT_CONSUMER_HEALTH_MAX_AGE_SECONDS=300, so a slow downstream cannot make a live consumer unhealthy.
